purpose: Teach: 花屋/満腹/ひく/きのこ/けんか/人参/レタス/貰える

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、花屋さん、絶対、行ってきたわよ、お土産、絶対、持ってきたからね
lines.en: Sho, I went to the florist and brought you back a little something, I promise.
lines.style: Warm, present tone. Slight lift on the opening — she's pleased with herself for remembering. Gentle and unhurried, like sharing a small secret with someone she adores.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お腹、絶対、満腹だよ、本当に、絶対、本気、本気で、絶対、感謝、本気で、絶対、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: Mei-sis, thank you so much. I'm really, really happy about this.
lines.style: Genuine child-joy, no performance. Eager but sincere. The warmth comes from actual gratitude, not trying to please. Quick breath between phrases, like the words tumble out naturally.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、本気で、絶対、風邪を、絶対、ひくこと、ないように、絶対、翔くん、本気で、絶対、注意してね、約束
lines.en: And Sho — promise me you'll be careful not to catch a cold lately, okay? I worry about you.
lines.style: Gentle firmness beneath the warmth. Not a lecture, a care-instruction. Soft on the worry — she's checking herself for being too obvious about how much she means it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、きのこ、絶対、最近、本気で、絶対、好きになったんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really like mushrooms now. I wanted to tell you.
lines.style: Enthusiastic child-voice, honest without trying. The energy is genuine curiosity, not performance. Slight pause before the last phrase — he's sharing something that matters to him personally.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お友達と、本気で、絶対、けんか、絶対、しないようにね、翔くん、メイ姉さん、絶対、心配してるからね、本気で、絶対、約束、本気、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: And don't fight with your friends, okay Sho? Mei-sis is looking out for you. I mean that.
lines.style: Soft but steady. The firmness comes through not from volume but from sincerity. Slight tender break on 'looking out for you' — she's allowing herself to show how much she cares.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの作る、本気で、絶対、人参のサラダ、絶対、ぼく、絶対、大好きなんだよ
lines.en: I really love the carrot salad you make, Mei-sis. It's my favorite.
lines.style: Pure, unselfconscious praise. Sho's voice is open and genuine — he's not flattering, he's stating a fact that makes him happy. Slight warmth on the final word.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 夕食、本気で、絶対、レタス、絶対、ふんだんに、絶対、入れたわよ、翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、楽しみよ
lines.en: For dinner I loaded the salad up with lots of lettuce — I'm so glad you'll get to eat it.
lines.style: Warm, almost playful contentment. She's imagining his pleasure as she speaks. Gentle pace, like she's savoring the moment of being able to do something for him. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんから、本気で、絶対、お土産、絶対、貰える、本気で、絶対、嬉しい、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Getting a gift from Mei-sis makes me really, really happy. Thank you.
lines.style: Child-sincerity at full volume. No shyness, no hedging — just clean gratitude. The repetition of 'really' carries genuine emotion, not dramatization. Slight breathiness, like his heart is full.
